title: Archi pack manifest (pack.yaml)
description: The smallest installable capability (ADR 0002 section 3.1). Every path is relative to the directory holding pack.yaml and must stay inside it.

name.description: Pack name. Must equal the directory name. Source ids render as <name>.<source>; init-question flags as --<name>-<id>.

kind.description: context packs bring sources, tool packs bring live tools, automation packs bring automations (ADR 0002 section 7.2).

modules.description: okg ontology modules this pack needs.

packs.description: Other packs this pack needs; resolved transitively.

schemas.description: Directory of LinkML schema slices, merged into the instance by relative path.

sources.description: Directory of source-registry templates, one <source>.yaml per source, whose single top-level key is <source>.

init_questions.description: YAML file with a top-level init_questions list, in okg's profile question format.

invariants.description: YAML file with a top-level invariants list. Owned by this pack: dropping the pack drops them.

freshness.description: Freshness SLOs keyed by rendered source id (<pack>.<source>). A context pack with sources declares one for every source; `archi doctor` compares each source's age, from okg's watermarks, to it.

max_staleness.description: Longest acceptable age of the source's last successful run: a positive integer and one unit of s, m, h, d or w (36h, 7d).

link_coverage.description: Link-coverage targets for the identifiers the pack carries. Composition turns each into an okg invariant named <pack>_link_<name> that is checked per generation.

from.description: Subtype of the nodes that carry the identifier.

to.description: Subtype the carriers must link to.

direction.description: out: from -[edge]-> to (default). in: to -[edge]-> from.

min_fraction.description: Share of `from` nodes that must have such an edge.

severity.description: warn (default) reports a miss; error blocks the publish.

playbooks.description: Directory of playbooks, installed into the instance's skills/ directory.

skill_triggers.description: YAML file of skill triggers (version + intents), merged by intent id.

search_subtypes.description: Subtypes added to the instance's `content` search profile.

search_profiles.description: Named okg search profiles the pack adds to the instance (deployment.yaml search.profiles). Not `content`, which is the union of search_subtypes.

live_tools.description: archi.tools.* entries exposed on the instance MCP server.

idempotent_tools.description: Live tools (a subset of live_tools) that honour the idempotency key the runtime passes: called twice with the same key they have the effect once. A tool used as the mediator of an action class that can run at L2 must be listed here (ADR 0002 section 7.2).

action_classes.description: YAML file with a top-level action_classes mapping keyed by action-class id (ADR 0002 section 7.2). Merged by id.

automation.description: The automation an automation pack declares (ADR 0002 section 7.2). Required for kind automation, refused for other kinds. Each action class named in `action_classes` is defined in the pack's top-level `action_classes` file.

trigger.description: What starts a run: type schedule (cron), ticket_queue (system, queue) or signal (source, condition). A ticket_queue names one system or a list of them; queue "*" means every ticket the instance's ticket sources ingest. The keys each type needs are checked by `archi bundles validate`.

context_gate.description: The context the automation needs (ADR 0002 section 6.3); the keys of archi.ops.context_gate.GateSpec: sources, max_staleness, min_context_eval_score (with max_age_days, default 14, at most 3650; context_eval_bundle, default the instance's only bundle; and the optional pins context_eval_k and context_eval_min_questions), invariants, published.

playbook.description: Playbook file, relative to the pack's `playbooks` directory.

action_classes.description: Ids of the action classes this automation may propose.

proposal_schema.description: JSON Schema every proposal must satisfy. Must require summary, evidence_ids, action_class, payload, confidence and rollback, the fields of the ops_proposal record.

budget.description: Spend and rate limits: cost_per_run and cost_per_day (USD, positive), runs_per_hour (positive integer).

narrow_to_selected.description: For an automation that can read several optional packs: keep only the context-gate sources and ticket_queue systems whose pack the instance selected, and refuse an instance that selected none of them. Without it every gate source must be installed.

evidence.description: Opt-in for a monitor whose evidence is the state of the instance, not graph nodes: `own_signals` lets a proposal cite the incident its own run wrote, allows a context gate that asks only `published: true` (the monitor must run while sources are stale), and allows workflow steps that run at L1 (`draft_issue`). Refused unless default_level is L0 or L1. Every other automation must cite a node of the pinned read and gate on freshness, invariants or a context-eval score (ADR 0002 D12).

default_level.description: Autonomy level the automation starts at when the instance sets none. L0, L1 or L2; anything above L2 is refused (ADR 0002 D13).

max_level.description: The bundle's upper bound on the instance's level for this automation. L0, L1 or L2 (ADR 0002 D13).

files.description: Files installed byte for byte at the same path in the deployment root (okg's profile `files:` allow-list applies).

prompt_fragment.description: Markdown appended to the chat system prompt, in resolution order.

prepare.description: Steps `archi init` and `archi add` run, in order, before okg's first ingest of this pack: they fetch or build the input a source reads from the data root (a records cache, for example). Each runs `python -m <module> <args>` in archi's own environment with ARCHI_DATA_ROOT set to the instance's data root and no shell. A step that exits non-zero or runs past its timeout stops the command; nothing is skipped quietly.

args.description: Arguments, passed as given (no shell). `${id}` is replaced by the answer to the pack's init question `id` (or a base question such as archi_data_root).

timeout.description: Seconds before the step is stopped and counted as failed. Default 600.

credentials.description: Environment-variable NAMES the pack reads. Never values.

needs_credentials.description: true when the pack cannot publish without a credential; such a pack cannot be a bundle's only default context pack.
